about: World hashes after N game days (N x steps_per_day steps from a fresh world). The ONE shared fixture for determinism evidence: asserted natively and in wasm by crates/client-wasm/tests/runner_golden.rs, and under the Bun runner by packages/runner/test/golden.test.ts. When sim-core changes the world on purpose, regenerate with: for each case, bun packages/runner/src/cli.ts run --seed S --days N --world W --json (sim.final.hash), then run both tests. Re-baselined for world format 2 (FEAT-079, ADR-0059): a standup nobody answers now raises a StandupFailed ticket, so every demo case that runs past 10:00 of day 0 moved; the step-0 world and the empty company (no meetings, tickets or work items) encode as before. Re-baselined for world format 3 (FEAT-087, ADR-0069): the plan carries workstreams and board days and every work item its planned days, so every case moved, the step-0 world and the empty company included; the editorial board is off unless a command turns it on, so no case holds one. Re-baselined for world format 4 (FEAT-097, ADR-0071): a work item's follow-up score and flag and the analytics policy. Re-baselined for world format 5 (FEAT-098, ADR-0073): the distribution policy. Re-baselined for world format 6 (FEAT-099, ADR-0074): remarks. Re-baselined for world format 7 (FEAT-090, FEAT-091, ADR-0072): the plan's structure and tools. Re-baselined for world format 8 (FEAT-026, ADR-0087): the town seeded at founding, the layout revision and the build mode. Re-baselined for world format 9 (FEAT-084, ADR-0087 decision 6): the plan's interiors, and the office designer in the hiring pool (the daily shortlist draws from one more persona). Re-baselined for world format 10 (ADR-0065 §4, ADR-0087 decision 7): the building's placed objects and the object id counter, so every case moved, the step-0 world and the empty company included.
